BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain Storage-Propositional)
(:requirements :typing)
(:types hoist surface place physob - object
	crate - physob
	container depot - place
	storearea transitarea - area
	area - surface)

(:predicates (clear ?s - storearea)
	     (in ?x - object ?p - place)
	     (available ?h - hoist)
	     (lifting ?h - hoist ?c - crate)
	     (at ?h - hoist ?a - area)
	     (on ?c - crate ?s - storearea)
	     (connected ?a1 ?a2 - area))

(:action lift
 :parameters (?h - hoist ?c - crate ?a1 - storearea ?a2 - area ?p - place)
 :precondition (and (available ?h) (at ?h ?a2) (on ?c ?a1) (in ?a1 ?p))
 :effect (and (not (on ?c ?a1)) (clear ?a1)
	      (not (available ?h)) (lifting ?h ?c) (not (in ?c ?p))))

(:action drop
 :parameters (?h - hoist ?c - crate ?a1 - storearea ?a2 - area ?p - place)
 :precondition (and (at ?h ?a2) (lifting ?h ?c) (clear ?a1) (in ?a1 ?p))
 :effect (and (not (lifting ?h ?c)) (available ?h)
	      (not (clear ?a1)) (on ?c ?a1) (in ?c ?p)))

(:action move
 :parameters (?h - hoist ?a1 ?a2 - storearea)
 :precondition (and (at ?h ?a1) (clear ?a2) (connected ?a1 ?a2))
 :effect (and (not (at ?h ?a1)) (at ?h ?a2)
	      (not (clear ?a2)) (clear ?a1)))

(:action go-out
 :parameters (?h - hoist ?a1 - storearea ?a2 - transitarea)
 :precondition (and (at ?h ?a1) (connected ?a1 ?a2))
 :effect (and (not (at ?h ?a1)) (at ?h ?a2) (clear ?a1)))

(:action go-in
 :parameters (?h - hoist ?a1 - transitarea ?a2 - storearea)
 :precondition (and (at ?h ?a1) (connected ?a1 ?a2) (clear ?a2))
 :effect (and (not (at ?h ?a1)) (at ?h ?a2) (not (clear ?a2))))
)
END DOMAIN
